comparison.objective: Attach red and black jump-lead clamps in a prescribed safe sequence; candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs and contains them.
comparison.physical_skill: Jump-lead task tests clamp placement and sequence compliance; candidate tests coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer impact control, withdrawal, and millimetre-scale recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Red must connect first, black must go to the separate ground rather than battery negative, and both clamps must be released; candidate requires four fractures, intact retained parts, and four deposited fragments.
comparison.reason: Safe ordered electrical clamping and impact-driven insert finishing have different central abilities and outcomes.
